title: Multispectral Images and Transcription of the Utrecht Sacramentary Palimpsest (Utrecht MS 1661, Sacramentarium Traiectense)
descriptions: These are the results of the multispectral imaging, subsequent processing and transcription of Utrecht Sacramentary Palimpsest (Utrecht MS 1661, Sacramentarium Traiectense). This data is used in an upcoming article which will be linked after publication.
